name: zclass_window_get_resolution
description: zClass_Window::gwWindowGetResolution validates a window node and returns the stored resolution width and height.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this window accessor; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass window/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x44f930 validates the null/type checks, zError no-op failure path, and resolution width/height loads from the window class data.
The native smoke verifies constructed window data and the accessor failure behavior for invalid nodes.
